user.title: Connect to your AirTouch
user.description: Enter the IP address of the AirTouch 2 or AirTouch 3 controller (the wall touch screen). Give it a fixed address in your router first so it doesn't change. The model is detected automatically.

data_description.host: IP address of the AirTouch controller on your network.
data_description.port: Leave as 8899 unless you know otherwise.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the IP address, that the controller is on Wi-Fi, and that nothing else is blocking port 8899.
error.unknown_device: Something answered, but it does not look like an AirTouch 2 or 3. AirTouch 2+, 4 and 5 use different protocols.

abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different AirTouch system.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the controller. Changes made from the wall panel or the phone app show up within this time.
